subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should #88204 remain the umbrella for the remaining session-routing/flooding work, or should maintainers close it after explicitly linking narrower canonical issues?
rationale: The unresolved parts cross core routing authority, external WeChat plugin ownership, Sessions UI activity semantics, and background-event policy, so automation should not choose the permanent boundary.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Use #88204 to track the cross-surface incident until #93255, #51028, and the WeChat/background-event follow-ups are resolved or deliberately split.

options.title: Split then close
options.body: Close #88204 only after maintainers name canonical replacements for each remaining bug family and copy the actionable evidence there.

options.title: Close as partial duplicate
options.body: Close this issue as too broad and rely on the existing narrower issues, accepting that the background flooding and WeChat plugin pieces may need fresh reports.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella open
recommendation.body: Use #88204 to track the cross-surface incident until #93255, #51028, and the WeChat/background-event follow-ups are resolved or deliberately split.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent main history carries the central sessions_send and session-state code paths, making this the best available routing owner from the inspected evidence.
